AI Workflow Automation

Stop writing a parser for every service. Pascal’s Pager uses AI to turn raw webhook JSON into clear iPhone Alerts. Give each service a private URL, tell Pascal what matters, and get a summary with key facts and useful links. Mask sensitive fields before AI processing, group related webhooks, and inspect the processed payloads for 30 days. Built for indie developers, side projects and home servers.
